# Franck Dimitri (Mr Dim's) - Full Stack Software Architect & Web Systems Engineer

## 1. Professional Identity & Biography

Franck Dimitri (legal name: **Mbouom Franck Dimitri**, professionally known as **Mr Dim's**) is a seasoned Full Stack Software Architect, Lead Web Engineer, and Technical Consultant based in Yaoundé, Cameroon, operating globally for clients worldwide.

He designs and delivers high-performance, fault-tolerant web applications, scalable backend microservices, robust financial technology integrations, and enterprise management systems. Combining engineering rigor with modern UI/UX design, Franck builds end-to-end digital solutions that turn complex business operations into elegant, reliable software.

## 2. Technical Stack & Engineering Capabilities

### Backend & Architecture
- **PHP**: PHP 8.2, PHP 8.3, PHP 8.4 with strict typing, OPcache tuning, and asynchronous processing.
- **Laravel Framework**: Versions 10, 11, 12, 13. Deep mastery of Eloquent ORM, Service Layer architecture, Form Requests, Sanctum/Passport authentication, Jobs & Queues (Redis-backed), Event Listeners, Notifications, Scheduling, and Custom Middleware.
- **Microservices & APIs**: RESTful JSON API specifications, GraphQL endpoints, WebSockets (Pusher / Laravel Echo), Server-Sent Events (SSE), API Rate Limiting, and Webhook dispatchers with HMAC verification.
- **Python**: Python 3.11+, Telegram Bot API (python-telegram-bot / telebot), system automation daemons, data analysis, and AI tool integrations.

### Frontend & User Experience
- **React**: React 18, React 19, functional components, custom hooks, context providers, state management, and optimized render cycles.
- **Inertia.js**: Inertia.js 1.x & 2.x connecting Laravel backend directly to React frontend without unnecessary API boilerplate while preserving full SPA fluidity and browser history state.
- **Styling & CSS**: Tailwind CSS (v3 and v4), PostCSS, CSS Modules, custom utility design systems, dark/light theme switching, and responsive design across all breakpoints.
- **Animations & Graphics**: Framer Motion for high-precision micro-interactions, WebGL shaders (OGL / Three.js), Canvas 2D particle systems, and hardware-accelerated animations.
- **TypeScript & JavaScript**: Modern ES6+ JavaScript, TypeScript definitions, strong typing, and bundler tooling via Vite.

### Databases & Storage
- **Relational Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL 8.x, SQLite 3. Advanced query optimization, execution plan analysis (`EXPLAIN ANALYZE`), foreign key constraints, transactional integrity (ACID), and schema migrations.
- **In-Memory Caching & Key-Value**: Redis for high-speed session management, query result caching, queue brokers, and rate limiting.
- **Object Storage**: AWS S3, Cloudinary CDN, MinIO, and local filesystem drivers with automated backups.

### DevOps, Linux & Infrastructure
- **Operating Systems**: Ubuntu Server (20.04, 22.04, 24.04 LTS), Debian, Arch Linux.
- **Web Servers & Gateways**: Nginx (reverse proxy, HTTP/2, Gzip/Brotli compression, SSL/TLS Let's Encrypt certificates via Certbot, security headers).
- **Service Management**: systemd service units, timer daemons, logrotate, and background job supervision.
- **Security & Hardening**: UFW firewall rules, fail2ban intrusion prevention, SSH key-only authentication, CSRF/XSS protection, and SQL injection prevention.
- **CI/CD & Version Control**: Git, GitHub, GitHub Actions automated deployment pipelines, automated migration runs, and zero-downtime deploy scripts.

## 3. Real-World Projects & Case Studies

### 1. Sellify - Escrow E-Commerce & Multi-Vendor Marketplace
- **Architecture**: Multi-tenant e-commerce platform built for high-trust transactions across Central and Western Africa.
- **Core Problem Solved**: Eliminating fraudulent online purchases through an automated escrow transaction engine. The customer's funds are held securely until the delivery is verified, protecting both buyers and vendors.
- **Key Features**:
  - Integration with Orange Money and MTN Mobile Money (MoMo) automated payment webhooks.
  - Multi-vendor storefronts with real-time stock and inventory level tracking.
  - Vendor analytics dashboard with sales reconciliation, payout requests, and performance metrics.
  - Dispute resolution workflow with customer support escalation.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, React, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, MySQL, Redis, Mobile Money APIs.

### 2. Saamaya BI - Banking Business Intelligence Platform
- **Architecture**: Enterprise financial analytics and risk assessment platform for microfinance institutions and credit unions.
- **Core Problem Solved**: Centralizing fragmented financial transaction data to provide real-time liquidity tracking and regulatory compliance with COBAC (Commission Bancaire de l'Afrique Centrale) standards.
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time loan portfolio health scoring (PAR - Portfolio at Risk).
  - Automated PDF/Excel regulatory report generation for central banking authorities.
  - Role-based granular permissions (Auditor, Branch Manager, Credit Analyst, Executive Board).
  - High-density data visualization charts using Chart.js.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, React, Tailwind CSS, PostgreSQL, Chart.js.

### 3. Polyclinic ERP - Hospital & Health Center Management System
- **Architecture**: Modular enterprise resource planning system for clinics, medical laboratories, and hospitals.
- **Core Problem Solved**: Transitioning healthcare facilities from slow paper records to encrypted, searchable Electronic Medical Records (EMR) while streamlining billing and pharmacy stock.
- **Key Features**:
  - Patient intake, medical history timeline, consultation notes, and doctor appointment scheduling.
  - Laboratory test order tracking with digital result delivery to doctors.
  - Pharmacy stock control with expiry alerts, batch tracking, and automated reorder points.
  - Insurance co-pay calculations and consolidated patient billing.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel, React, Inertia.js, MySQL, Tailwind CSS.

### 4. Telegram Server Telemetry & Lead Management Bot
- **Architecture**: Background daemon monitoring Linux VPS health metrics and dispatching automated client interaction alerts.
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time CPU, RAM, disk space, and Nginx access logs monitoring.
  - Instant notifications sent to Franck Dimitri when a prospect submits a contact or quote request.
  - Autonomous interactive menu allowing authenticated administrators to inspect server logs remotely via Telegram commands.
- **Tech Stack**: Python 3, python-telegram-bot, systemd, SQLite, Linux shell.

### 5. Architectural Portfolio System (mrdims.dev)
- **Architecture**: Custom architectural blueprint-inspired personal platform with real-time analytics.
- **Key Features**:
  - Interactive project budget estimator with automated quotation calculation.
  - Bilingual interface (French & English) with persistent language state.
  - Live visitor telemetry and CV download analytics dashboard.
  - Custom markdown tech blog with automated reading time, table of contents, and syntax highlighting.
- **Tech Stack**: Laravel 11, React 18, Inertia.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, WebGL shaders.
